modules.name: SupoClip
modules.description: Turn long-form video into viral 9:16 clips with AI segment selection, word-synced captions, and face-centered cropping.

modules.name: Flowsint
modules.description: Visual, extensible entity-graph investigations: domains, IPs, ASNs, WHOIS, subdomain discovery and other enrichers.

modules.name: MiroFish
modules.description: Spawns societies of AI agents from real-world seed data (news, reports, drafts) and simulates how events unfold, producing prediction reports.

modules.name: changedetection.io
modules.description: Monitors any webpage, price, or API for changes and fires notifications — the hub's tripwire for things without feeds.

modules.name: RSSHub
modules.description: Generates feeds for sources that don't have them — X accounts, subreddits, YouTube channels, GitHub releases — which the Signal Feed can then ingest.

modules.name: OpenBB
modules.description: Equities, options, crypto, and macro research platform. The deep-dive companion to the Markets panel. Setup: pip install openbb, then run openbb-api (see hub README).

modules.name: Local LLM
modules.description: Run models locally — free unlimited tokens for MiroFish sims and clip selection. Start with: make llm (docker profile).

modules.name: Firecrawl
modules.description: Turns any web page into LLM-ready markdown — the feeder for MiroFish sims, clip context, and research. Self-hosted API.

modules.name: Perplexica
modules.description: Self-hosted Perplexity backed by SearXNG — ask anything, get cited answers, no API cost.

modules.name: Karakeep
modules.description: Save links, tweets, and notes with automatic AI tagging and full-text search — the hub's memory of things worth keeping.

modules.name: ntfy
modules.description: Self-hosted push. The hub's watcher sends market moves, alerts, and the morning brief here; subscribe on your phone.

modules.name: Uptime Kuma
modules.description: Proper uptime monitoring with history, SLAs, and its own notifications — heavier-duty than the built-in status checks.

modules.name: Outline
modules.description: Searchable wiki where MiroFish reports and morning briefs accumulate over time. Setup needs Postgres/Redis (see hub README).

modules.name: ComfyUI
modules.description: Node-based interface for local AI video/image generation (Wan 2.2, LTX-Video, etc.). Generates B-roll/intros for /clip with no per-render cost. Needs an NVIDIA GPU (>=12GB VRAM): make gpu.
